lines.text: The LORD's new song is sung from the ends of the earth, and Sela's people cry out from the mountaintops.
The villages of Midian are told to cry aloud, and the LORD goes forth like a mighty one.
The LORD will groan like a woman in labor and lead the blind by a way they did not know.
Those who trust in idols will be turned back in shame, and God asks who is blind like His servant.
Jacob was given up because they would not walk in His ways, and the anger enveloped them in floods.
